meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs a punch-in, punch-out, zoom, reframe, Ken Burns treatment, camera move, visual match/whip handoff, or other seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes; also for GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加推拉缩放、运镜和转场关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想给视频片段添加电影感的推拉缩放和运镜动画
copy.tagline_en: Add punch-in, zoom, reframe, and camera-move keyframes to video compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you edit video and want cinematic push-in, zoom, and camera-move animation

howto.what: 在 HyperFrames 合成里为元素写关键帧动画：推近拉远、缩放与画面重构、Ken Burns 运镜、遮罩、SVG 描边变形等，并用 lint、check、keyframes 等命令校验产出画面。
howto.when: 当 HyperFrames 合成需要推近/拉远、缩放重构画面、Ken Burns 运镜等关键帧效果，或用 GSAP、CSS 关键帧等方式写作时接管；不做整体场景策略、品牌设计、素材采购。

say.text: 给这个主体做一段先推近再回落的缩放关键帧
say.note: 会按 seek-safe 规则写关键帧并跑诊断

say.text: 用 GSAP 时间线写多段缩放状态，保持主体不变
用 clip-path 遮罩做一次方向性擦除转场
say.note: 只动片段内包装层的裁剪，不改源时间

howto.what_en: Writes keyframes for elements in a HyperFrames composition: punch-in/out, zoom, reframe, Ken Burns camera moves, masks, SVG draw/morph, then verifies pixels with lint, check, and keyframes diagnostics.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a HyperFrames composition needs punch-in/out, zoom or Ken Burns camera moves, etc., or keyframes authored via GSAP, CSS, WAAPI, etc. Not for scene strategy or brand design.

say_en.text: Add a punch-in zoom on this subject, then ease back out.
say_en.note: Writes seek-safe keyframes and runs diagnostics.

say_en.text: Author multi-state zoom in a GSAP timeline, keeping one subject.
say_en.note: Builds a paused timeline registered on window.__timelines.

say_en.text: Do a directional wipe transition with a clip-path mask.
say_en.note: Animates crop on a wrapper inside the clip only.
